meta.title: Strumming thin air: why grown-ups fly to Finland to play guitars that do not exist
meta.deck: Every summer, a small city near the Arctic Circle hosts a contest in which the instruments are invisible and the stakes are, by design, very low.
meta.note: 这是一篇仿《经济学人》风格的原创练习文章，不是真实外刊的转载。文中的事实是概括性描述，仅供语言学习，请不要当作引用来源。

sents.en: Strumming thin air: why grown-ups fly to Finland to play guitars that do not exist
sents.zh: 对着空气扫弦：成年人为什么飞到芬兰，去弹根本不存在的吉他
notes: strum：用手指或拨片扫弦，弹吉他的典型动作。
thin air：稀薄的空气，常见于 out of thin air（凭空）。这里说“对着空气弹”。
grown-ups：大人、成年人，比 adults 口语。

sents.en: Every summer, a small city near the Arctic Circle hosts a contest in which the instruments are invisible and the stakes are, by design, very low.
sents.zh: 每年夏天，北极圈附近的一座小城都会举办一场比赛：乐器是隐形的，输赢也被刻意设计得无关紧要。
notes: host：（城市、国家）举办活动，动词。
in which 引导定语从句，修饰 a contest。
the stakes are low：输赢没什么大不了。by design 插在中间：是故意这样设计的。

sents.en: Yet the event takes its silliness very seriously, and that may be the secret of its charm.
sents.zh: 可这个活动对自己的傻气却极其认真，而这也许正是它的魅力所在。
notes: takes ... seriously：认真对待……。
silliness：傻气、滑稽，形容词 silly 的名词。
the secret of its charm：它魅力的秘诀。

sents.en: Picture a stage, a roaring crowd and a performer in leather trousers, eyes shut, fingers flying across a guitar that is not there.
sents.zh: 想象一个舞台、一群欢呼的观众，还有一位穿皮裤的表演者：双眼紧闭，手指在一把并不存在的吉他上飞舞。
notes: Picture ...：想象一下……，祈使句开头，把读者拉进场景。
eyes shut, fingers flying：独立主格结构，补充描写人的状态。
a guitar that is not there：不存在的吉他，全文的笑点。

sents.en: For 60 seconds he leaps, kneels and pulls faces to a song he did not choose, then bows as if he had just played a sold-out stadium.
sents.zh: 整整 60 秒，他跟着一首不是自己选的歌又跳又跪、挤眉弄眼，然后鞠躬谢幕，仿佛刚在座无虚席的体育场开完演唱会。
notes: leaps, kneels and pulls faces：三个动作并列，节奏很快。
a song he did not choose：比赛曲目是指定的，选手自己不能挑。
as if he had just played ...：仿佛刚刚……，as if 后用过去完成时，表示和事实相反的想象。

sents.en: This is the Air Guitar World Championships, held in Oulu, Finland, since 1996.
sents.zh: 这就是空气吉他世界锦标赛，自 1996 年起在芬兰的奥卢举办。
notes: held in ...：过去分词短语作定语，= which has been held in ...。
Oulu：奥卢，芬兰北部城市。

sents.en: What began as a joke at a local music festival has grown into an international fixture, with national champions from dozens of countries competing for the title.
sents.zh: 它起初只是当地音乐节上的一个玩笑，如今已成为固定的国际赛事，几十个国家的全国冠军都来争夺这个头衔。
notes: What began as a joke ...：what 引导主语从句，“当初作为玩笑开始的东西”。
grow into：（逐渐）发展成，之前学过。
with + 名词 + -ing：伴随状况，补充说明比赛规模。

sents.en: The rules are short and strict.
sents.zh: 规则很短，也很严格。
notes: 两个形容词并列，句子短，读起来干脆，呼应“规则简短”。

sents.en: Contestants may not touch a real instrument, nor may they rely on backing musicians; the guitar must be entirely imaginary.
sents.zh: 选手不许碰真乐器，也不许靠伴奏乐手；吉他必须完全是想象出来的。
notes: nor may they ...：也不可以……。nor 放句首要倒装：助动词 may 提到主语 they 前面。
rely on：依靠、依赖。
imaginary：想象中的、虚构的。

sents.en: Judges score each performance on technical skill, stage presence and a hard-to-define quality the organisers call 'airness'.
sents.zh: 评委按技术、台风，以及一种主办方称为“空气感”、很难说清的特质给每场表演打分。
notes: score ... on ...：按……打分。
stage presence：台风、舞台魅力。
a hard-to-define quality：用连字符把短语变成形容词，“难以定义的特质”。

sents.en: A good air guitarist, in other words, must convince the audience that the music is coming from his fingers, not the speakers.
sents.zh: 换句话说，一位优秀的空气吉他手必须让观众相信：音乐来自他的手指，而不是音箱。
notes: in other words：换句话说，插在主语和谓语之间。
convince sb that ...：让某人相信……。

sents.en: Mistakes are allowed, but only if they are made with conviction.
sents.zh: 犯错是允许的，但前提是错得理直气壮。
notes: only if：只有在……的情况下。
with conviction：满怀信念地、理直气壮地。

sents.en: To outsiders, it can look like an elaborate excuse to dress up and show off.
sents.zh: 在外人看来，这可能像是一个煞费苦心的借口，好让人盛装打扮、尽情炫耀。
notes: To outsiders：在外人看来。
elaborate：精心的、复杂的。
dress up：打扮、穿上特别的衣服；show off：炫耀。

sents.en: Competitors beg to differ.
sents.zh: 选手们可不这么认为。
notes: beg to differ：恕我不能同意，礼貌而带点调侃的反对。

sents.en: Many have practised for months in front of a mirror, studying the moves of rock legends frame by frame.
sents.zh: 很多人对着镜子练了好几个月，一帧一帧地研究摇滚传奇们的动作。
notes: practise：英式拼法，动词；美式写 practice。
studying ...：伴随动作。
frame by frame：一帧一帧地。

sents.en: Some insist that air guitar is a genuine art form, one that demands timing, stamina and a total lack of embarrassment.
sents.zh: 有些人坚称空气吉他是一门真正的艺术，它需要节奏感、体力，还要完全不怕难为情。
notes: insist that ...：坚持说、坚称。
one that ...：= an art form that ...，用 one 避免重复。
a total lack of embarrassment：完全没有尴尬感，幽默的说法。

sents.en: After a single minute on stage, several admit, they are as out of breath as any athlete.
sents.zh: 好几位选手承认，在台上只待一分钟，他们就累得和运动员一样上气不接下气。
notes: several admit 插在句中，相当于 several admit that ...。
as ... as any athlete：不亚于任何运动员。
out of breath：喘不过气。

sents.en: The festival also wears a cheerful philosophy on its sleeve.
sents.zh: 这个节日还毫不掩饰地亮出一套乐呵呵的哲学。
notes: wear sth on one's sleeve：把……挂在袖子上，引申为毫不掩饰（感情、立场）。

sents.en: Its organisers like to joke that you cannot hold a weapon while playing air guitar, so if everyone took it up, wars might simply stop.
sents.zh: 主办方爱开玩笑说：弹空气吉他的时候没法拿武器，所以如果人人都玩起来，战争说不定就停了。
notes: joke that ...：开玩笑说。
if everyone took it up, wars might ...：虚拟语气，对现在的假设，用过去式。
take up：开始（一项爱好、运动）。

sents.en: Nobody pretends this is a serious peace plan, but the slogan captures the spirit of the thing: harmless, generous and slightly absurd.
sents.zh: 没人假装这是认真的和平方案，但这句口号抓住了这项活动的精髓：无害、大方，还有点荒唐。
notes: pretend (that) ...：假装。
capture the spirit of：抓住……的精神、精髓。
冒号后用三个形容词概括。

sents.en: There is something refreshing about a contest in which no one can be accused of having an unfair advantage.
sents.zh: 一场谁也不会被指责占了不公平优势的比赛，自有一种让人耳目一新的地方。
notes: There is something + 形容词 + about ...：……有种……的感觉。
be accused of doing：被指责做了……。
an unfair advantage：不公平的优势。

sents.en: No expensive equipment is needed, and a child with enough nerve can, in principle, beat a professional musician.
sents.zh: 不需要昂贵的设备，一个胆子够大的孩子，理论上也能打败专业音乐人。
notes: nerve：胆量、勇气。
in principle：理论上、原则上，插在情态动词和动词之间。

sents.en: In an age when so much of life is measured, ranked and sold, a world title for doing nothing at all is a small act of rebellion.
sents.zh: 在一个生活里太多东西都要被衡量、排名、拿来卖钱的时代，一项“什么都不做”的世界冠军，算是一种小小的反叛。
notes: In an age when ...：在……的时代，when 引导定语从句修饰 age。
measured, ranked and sold：三个过去分词并列。
an act of rebellion：一种反叛行为。

sents.en: And unlike most championships, this one leaves its fans with nothing worse than a sore throat.
sents.zh: 而且和大多数锦标赛不同，这一场留给粉丝的，最糟也不过是喊哑了的嗓子。
notes: leave sb with sth：给某人留下……。
nothing worse than：最糟也不过是。
a sore throat：喉咙痛。

sents.en: The guitars may be imaginary; the joy, judging by the crowds, is anything but.
sents.zh: 吉他也许是想象出来的；可从观众的热情来看，那份快乐绝不是假的。
notes: 分号前后对比：吉他是虚的，快乐是真的。
judging by ...：从……来判断，插在句中。
anything but：绝不是。is anything but (imaginary)，省略了重复的 imaginary。

vocab.note: 吉他、尤克里里的弹法：strum a guitar。也可以说手指无聊地敲：strum on the table。

ex.en: He sat on the steps, [[strumming]] an old guitar.
ex.zh: 他坐在台阶上，拨着一把旧吉他。

ex.en: She [[strummed]] a few chords and began to sing.
ex.zh: 她扫了几个和弦，开始唱歌。

vocab.note: 最常见的搭配：out of thin air（凭空、无中生有），vanish into thin air（消失得无影无踪）。

ex.en: The money seemed to appear out of [[thin air]].
ex.zh: 那笔钱好像是凭空冒出来的。

ex.en: My keys can't just vanish into [[thin air]]!
ex.zh: 我的钥匙不可能凭空消失吧！

vocab.note: 城市、国家、机构举办活动：host the Olympics。名词 host 是主人、主持人。

ex.en: Paris [[hosted]] the Olympic Games in 2024.
ex.zh: 巴黎在 2024 年举办了奥运会。

ex.en: Our school [[hosts]] a book fair every spring.
ex.zh: 我们学校每年春天办一次书展。

vocab.note: 反义是 by accident / by chance（偶然）。Was it by accident or by design?（是偶然还是故意的？）

ex.en: The café is small [[by design]]; the owner wants it to feel cosy.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆小是故意的，老板想让它显得温馨。

ex.en: Whether [[by design]] or by accident, the plan worked.
ex.zh: 不管是有意还是偶然，这个计划奏效了。

vocab.note: 常用复数：the stakes are high（事关重大）/ low（无关紧要）。high-stakes exam：决定命运的考试。

ex.en: With the final exam next week, the [[stakes]] are high.
ex.zh: 下周就期末考了，事关重大。

ex.en: It's just a friendly game, so the [[stakes]] are low.
ex.zh: 只是友谊赛，输赢无所谓。

vocab.note: 可数时也指护身符、小挂件。形容词 charming（迷人的）。part of the charm：魅力的一部分。

ex.en: The old town has a quiet [[charm]].
ex.zh: 老城有一种安静的魅力。

ex.en: The tiny kitchen is part of the flat's [[charm]].
ex.zh: 小小的厨房也是这套公寓的魅力之一。

vocab.zh: 轰鸣的、喧闹的；（生意）兴隆的
vocab.note: roar 是咆哮、轰鸣。a roaring crowd（欢声雷动的人群），a roaring fire（熊熊炉火），a roaring success（巨大成功）。

ex.en: We sat by a [[roaring]] fire and drank cocoa.
ex.zh: 我们坐在熊熊的炉火边喝可可。

ex.en: The show was a [[roaring]] success.
ex.zh: 演出大获成功。

vocab.note: 比 jump 更书面、更有力。过去式 leapt 或 leaped。leap at the chance（抓住机会）。

ex.en: The cat [[leapt]] onto the table.
ex.zh: 猫一下跳上了桌子。

ex.en: She [[leaps]] out of bed the moment the alarm rings.
ex.zh: 闹钟一响她就从床上蹦起来。

vocab.note: 英式说法，美式多说 make faces。pull a face 也可以表示“露出不情愿的表情”。

ex.en: The kids [[pulled faces]] at the camera.
ex.zh: 孩子们对着镜头做鬼脸。

ex.en: He [[pulled a face]] when he tasted the medicine.
ex.zh: 他一尝那药就皱起了脸。

vocab.note: as if 后面用过去时或过去完成时，表示“其实并不是这样”：He talks as if he knew everything.（他说话好像什么都知道，其实不然）。说过去的事用 had done。

ex.en: She looked at me [[as if]] I had said something rude.
ex.zh: 她看着我，好像我说了什么失礼的话。

ex.en: He acts [[as if]] he were the boss.
ex.zh: 他表现得好像他是老板似的。

vocab.conn: 主句 + as if + 主语 + 过去时 / 过去完成时（与事实相反）

pick.q: He talked about Paris as if he ___ there many times, but he never had.
pick.why: 其实他没去过，是和过去事实相反的想象，as if 后用过去完成时 had been。

pick.q: She was so calm, ___ nothing had happened.
pick.why: “好像什么都没发生”用 as if；even if 是“即使”，意思不对。

vocab.zh: 固定节目、常设活动；固定装置
vocab.note: a fixture of / on the calendar：日程上雷打不动的活动。也指人：He is a fixture at the café（他是这家店的常客）。

ex.en: The Christmas market is a [[fixture]] of the city's winter.
ex.zh: 圣诞市集是这座城市冬天的固定节目。

ex.en: The old man became a [[fixture]] in the park.
ex.zh: 那位老人成了公园里的老面孔。

vocab.note: compete for + 目标（title, prize, jobs），compete with / against + 对手，compete in + 比赛。

ex.en: Ten teams will [[compete for]] the cup.
ex.zh: 十支队伍将争夺奖杯。

ex.en: Shops are [[competing for]] fewer customers.
ex.zh: 商店在争抢越来越少的顾客。

vocab.expr: nor + 助动词 + 主语（倒装）
vocab.note: 前面已经是否定句，接着说“也不……”，用 nor，后面要倒装：助动词 / be / 情态动词放到主语前。I can't swim, nor can my brother.（我不会游泳，我弟弟也不会）。口语里常用 neither 代替。

ex.en: I don't like coffee, [[nor]] does my sister.
ex.zh: 我不喜欢咖啡，我姐姐也不喜欢。

ex.en: He never called, [[nor]] did he write.
ex.zh: 他从没打过电话，也没写过信。

vocab.conn: 否定句, nor + 助动词 / be / 情态动词 + 主语 + ...

pick.q: She didn't come to the party, nor ___ a message.
pick.why: nor 开头要倒装，助动词 did 放到主语 she 前：nor did she send。

pick.q: I can't drive, ___ can my husband.
pick.why: 前面是否定，“也不会”用 nor；so can my husband 是“他也会”，用在肯定句后。

vocab.note: rely on sb / sth (to do)。名词 reliance，形容词 reliable（可靠的）。比之前学的 count on 正式一点。

ex.en: Many villages [[rely on]] tourism.
ex.zh: 很多村子靠旅游业为生。

ex.en: You can [[rely on]] her to keep a secret.
ex.zh: 你可以放心她会保守秘密。

vocab.note: 注意和 imaginative（富有想象力的）区分：an imaginary friend（想象出来的朋友），an imaginative child（想象力丰富的孩子）。

ex.en: As a child she had an [[imaginary]] friend called Bo.
ex.zh: 她小时候有个叫 Bo 的想象中的朋友。

ex.en: The line between the two countries is [[imaginary]]; there is no fence.
ex.zh: 两国之间的界线只是想象中的，并没有围栏。

vocab.note: presence 本身也有“气场、风度”的意思：She has real presence.（她很有气场）。

ex.en: The young singer has great [[stage presence]].
ex.zh: 那位年轻歌手台风很好。

ex.en: Good teachers need a bit of [[stage presence]] too.
ex.zh: 好老师也需要一点台风。

vocab.note: 用来换个说法解释前面的话，常放句首或插在句中。

ex.en: He's between jobs; [[in other words]], he's unemployed.
ex.zh: 他正处在两份工作之间，换句话说，他失业了。

ex.en: [[In other words]], we need more time.
ex.zh: 也就是说，我们需要更多时间。

vocab.note: convince sb that ... / of sth：让人相信。convince sb to do：说服某人去做（英式也用 persuade）。形容词 convincing（令人信服的）。

ex.en: She [[convinced]] me that the plan would work.
ex.zh: 她让我相信这个计划行得通。

ex.en: It took hours to [[convince]] him to see a doctor.
ex.zh: 花了好几个小时才说服他去看医生。

vocab.note: conviction 是坚定的信念；也有“定罪”的意思（法律用语）。speak with conviction：说得斩钉截铁。

ex.en: She spoke [[with conviction]] about her plans.
ex.zh: 她坚定地谈起自己的计划。

ex.en: Even wrong notes sound fine if you play them [[with conviction]].
ex.zh: 就算弹错音，只要弹得自信也挺好听。

vocab.note: 形容词读 /ɪˈlæbərət/；作动词“详细说明”读 /ɪˈlæbəreɪt/：Could you elaborate?（能详细说说吗？）

ex.en: They made an [[elaborate]] cake for the wedding.
ex.zh: 他们为婚礼做了一个精致的蛋糕。

ex.en: He gave an [[elaborate]] excuse for being late.
ex.zh: 他为迟到编了一套复杂的借口。

vocab.note: dress up for a party（为聚会打扮），dress up as a pirate（扮成海盗）。

ex.en: Do I need to [[dress up]] for dinner tonight?
ex.zh: 今晚吃饭需要穿得正式点吗？

ex.en: The children [[dressed up]] as animals.
ex.zh: 孩子们扮成了各种动物。

vocab.note: show off + 东西：炫耀……（show off his new car）。名词 a show-off：爱显摆的人。

ex.en: He loves to [[show off]] his new car.
ex.zh: 他很爱炫耀他的新车。

ex.en: Stop [[showing off]] and just finish your food.
ex.zh: 别显摆了，好好把饭吃完。

vocab.zh: 恕难苟同、我不这么认为
vocab.note: 礼貌地表示反对，常带幽默：I beg to differ.（我不敢苟同。）

ex.en: You say it's too cold to swim? I [[beg to differ]].
ex.zh: 你说太冷不能游泳？我可不这么觉得。

ex.en: Critics hated the film, but audiences [[begged to differ]].
ex.zh: 影评人讨厌这部电影，观众却不这么看。

vocab.zh: 一帧一帧地；逐步细致地
vocab.note: frame 是电影、视频的一帧。类似结构：step by step（一步一步）、day by day（一天天）。

ex.en: The coach watched the race video [[frame by frame]].
ex.zh: 教练一帧一帧地看比赛录像。

ex.en: We went through the problem [[frame by frame]].
ex.zh: 我们把这个问题一点一点地过了一遍。

vocab.note: insist that + 句子（坚称），insist on + 名词 / doing（坚持要）：She insisted on paying.（她坚持要付钱）。

ex.en: He [[insists]] that he saw a ghost.
ex.zh: 他坚称自己见过鬼。

ex.en: My mother [[insisted]] on driving me to the station.
ex.zh: 我妈坚持要开车送我去车站。

vocab.note: 不可数。build up stamina（增强耐力）。

ex.en: Marathon runners need a lot of [[stamina]].
ex.zh: 跑马拉松需要很好的耐力。

ex.en: I don't have the [[stamina]] to shop all day.
ex.zh: 我没那个体力逛一整天街。

vocab.zh: 上气不接下气、气喘吁吁
vocab.note: be / get out of breath。反过来 catch one's breath（喘口气）。

ex.en: I was [[out of breath]] after climbing the stairs.
ex.zh: 爬完楼梯我喘得不行。

ex.en: She arrived [[out of breath]] but on time.
ex.zh: 她气喘吁吁地赶到，好在没迟到。

vocab.note: 最常见：wear your heart on your sleeve（喜怒形于色、不掩饰感情）。sleeve 是袖子。

ex.en: He wears his heart [[on his sleeve]].
ex.zh: 他喜怒全写在脸上。

ex.en: The band wears its politics [[on its sleeve]].
ex.zh: 这支乐队毫不掩饰自己的政治立场。

vocab.zh: 开始从事（爱好、运动）；占用
vocab.note: take up a hobby / yoga / the piano。另一个意思是占用：take up space / time。

ex.en: She [[took up]] painting after she retired.
ex.zh: 她退休后开始画画。

ex.en: This sofa [[takes up]] half the room.
ex.zh: 这张沙发占了半个房间。

vocab.zh: 捕捉、抓住（精髓、注意力）；俘获
vocab.note: capture the spirit / mood（抓住精神 / 氛围），capture attention（吸引注意）。也指拍下画面：capture a moment。

ex.en: The photo [[captures]] the joy of the moment.
ex.zh: 这张照片捕捉到了那一刻的喜悦。

ex.en: The song [[captured]] the mood of the summer.
ex.zh: 这首歌唱出了那个夏天的氛围。

vocab.note: harm（伤害）+ -less（没有）。a harmless joke（无伤大雅的玩笑）。反义 harmful。

ex.en: Most spiders are [[harmless]].
ex.zh: 大多数蜘蛛是无害的。

ex.en: It was just a [[harmless]] joke.
ex.zh: 那只是个无伤大雅的玩笑。

vocab.note: 比 silly 更强，常带“不合常理”的意思。名词 absurdity。

ex.en: It's [[absurd]] to pay that much for a sandwich.
ex.zh: 一个三明治卖那么贵，太离谱了。

ex.en: The idea sounded [[absurd]] at first.
ex.zh: 这个主意一开始听起来很荒唐。

vocab.zh: 令人耳目一新的；提神的
vocab.note: refreshing honesty（难得的坦诚），a refreshing drink（清爽的饮料）。

ex.en: It's [[refreshing]] to meet someone so honest.
ex.zh: 遇到这么坦诚的人，真让人耳目一新。

ex.en: A cold glass of lemonade is very [[refreshing]].
ex.zh: 一杯冰柠檬水很解渴提神。

vocab.note: accuse sb of (doing) sth：指责某人……。注意介词用 of，不是 for。名词 accusation。

ex.en: He was [[accused of]] cheating in the exam.
ex.zh: 他被指控考试作弊。

ex.en: The company was [[accused of]] hiding the truth.
ex.zh: 这家公司被指责隐瞒真相。

vocab.note: have / gain / give sb an unfair advantage。have an advantage over sb：比某人有优势。

ex.en: Using a calculator would give you an [[unfair advantage]].
ex.zh: 用计算器会让你占不公平的便宜。

ex.en: Rich families can buy their children an [[unfair advantage]].
ex.zh: 有钱人家能给孩子买来不公平的优势。

vocab.note: have the nerve to do：有胆量做（也可以是“竟敢”）。lose one's nerve：临阵退缩。get on sb's nerves：让人心烦。

ex.en: I didn't have the [[nerve]] to ask her out.
ex.zh: 我没胆量约她出去。

ex.en: Loud music gets on my [[nerves]].
ex.zh: 吵闹的音乐让我心烦。

vocab.note: 常和 in practice（实际上，之前学过）对比：In principle it's easy; in practice it's hard.

ex.en: [[In principle]], anyone can apply.
ex.zh: 原则上谁都可以申请。

ex.en: We agree [[in principle]], but the details need work.
ex.zh: 我们原则上同意，但细节还需要再谈。

vocab.note: 也说 in an era when / at a time when。when 引导定语从句，后面接完整句子。

ex.en: [[In an age when]] everyone has a phone, few people wear watches.
ex.zh: 在人人都有手机的时代，很少有人戴手表。

ex.en: [[In an age when]] news travels fast, rumours spread faster.
ex.zh: 在消息传得飞快的时代，谣言传得更快。

vocab.note: 动词 rebel（反抗），形容词 rebellious（叛逆的）：a rebellious teenager。

ex.en: Dyeing her hair green was her small [[rebellion]].
ex.zh: 把头发染成绿色是她的小小叛逆。

ex.en: The king crushed the [[rebellion]].
ex.zh: 国王镇压了起义。

vocab.note: 肌肉酸痛、喉咙痛常用 sore：a sore throat, sore legs。sore point：痛处、敏感话题。

ex.en: My legs are [[sore]] after yesterday's run.
ex.zh: 昨天跑完步腿好酸。

ex.en: I've got a [[sore]] throat, so I'll stay home.
ex.zh: 我嗓子疼，就待在家吧。

vocab.note: 也说 judging from。Judging by his face, the news was bad.（看他的脸色，消息不好）。

ex.en: [[Judging by]] the queue, the food must be good.
ex.zh: 看这排队的阵势，菜一定好吃。

ex.en: [[Judging by]] her smile, she passed the test.
ex.zh: 看她笑得这么开心，应该是考过了。

vocab.note: anything but + 形容词 = 一点也不：The hotel was anything but cheap.（那家酒店一点也不便宜）。注意和 nothing but（只是）意思相反。

ex.en: The exam was [[anything but]] easy.
ex.zh: 这次考试一点也不简单。

ex.en: He looked [[anything but]] happy.
ex.zh: 他看起来一点也不开心。

cloze.hint: 开始从事（___ it up，过去式）

breakdown.en: In an age when so much of life is measured, ranked and sold, a world title for doing nothing at all is a small act of rebellion.
points: 句子主干是 a world title ... is a small act of rebellion：一项世界冠军是一种小小的反叛。
In an age when so much of life is measured, ranked and sold：时间状语，when 引导定语从句修饰 age，三个过去分词并列说明“生活被怎样对待”。
a world title for doing nothing at all：for 说明冠军颁给什么，doing nothing at all 指空气吉他“什么都没真弹”。
作者的观点：在一切都被量化和商品化的时代，这种“毫无用处”的比赛反而显得可贵。
